data.content_ref: inline:SRC_004 criticizes SRC_007's $909 as relying on a non-standard, unstated premium-only method. This is compatible with the observation that SRC_007 numerically overcounts by $54 ($909−$855), which equals exactly 7×$9−7×$0 = 7 overtime hours paid an extra half-time premium on top of already-included base pay. SRC_007's error reduces to a decomposition mismatch: it adds a premium to a base that already covers all hours, whereas the standard method replaces (not augments) the base rate with 1.5×base for overtime hours. It is refuted if the premium-only method is explicitly endorsed by the problem or jurisdiction as equivalent to the standard method.
